text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa wasn't feeling well, so I 
decided to let her rest in the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...I'm going to sleep for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yo, I've been waiting for ya, Nakayama. 
Can count on one hand how many times 
that's happened.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Golshi... You're not waiting at all.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Never mind the details, here's your 
present! Open it right now! Come on, 
hurry!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Ah...? What're you scheming...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I-It is nothing of the sort! It is 
merely a gift, hand-rolled sushi?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh, that's a lousy lie. Or wait... is 
it a bluff?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Going along with it could be fun. 
Whether it brings a demon or a serpent... 
let's see what happens!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Wh... Golshi is to me—?!

text_block_list.name: Fake Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Fuhahahaha, a roaring success! Now all I 
gotta do is win at Old Maid, and this form 
is all Golshi-chan's!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You...! For starters, stop talking like 
that with my face!

text_block_list.name: Fake Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, if you don't like it, just beat 
me! Here, you can draw from Nakayama 
first.

text_block_list.name: Fake Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, matched another pair! This is so easy, 
even my yawns checked out early!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(Didn't draw the short straw again, huh... 
Even though I set it up so carefully—)

text_block_list.name: Fake Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"—...is what you're thinking, right?! I 
can see right through your mind, 
Nakayama!"

text_block_list.name: Fake Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Because I'm a Nakayama too, ya know!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
With that body, you can read my thoughts, 
can you...? Heh heh... I see.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—However, looks like you didn't see my 
trick coming. Take a look at your hand!

text_block_list.name: Fake Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ack?! I drew two cards! —Wait, you made me 
foul on purpose, didn't you?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Of course I knew you were reading my 
thoughts. Because you're me...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Our conditions are completely identical. 
Now then, let the mind games and deception 
begin!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh, that sent shivers down my 
spine...! That was the most damn fun dream 
ever!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that dream full of burning 
passion, Nakayama Festa was able to regain 
her form!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... It won't open... What's with this 
box...?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Here, lemme try—nghh-ghh-ghh! What the 
heck is this!? Is it defective!?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"You set this up, didn't you...! Dammit, 
it won't budge an inch...!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh? Was it just a dream...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Damn it, what on earth was inside that 
box...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps having had an unpleasant dream, 
Nakayama Festa's condition remained poor.
